fact: Car 20 allegedly undertook a practice start at pit exit.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 i) of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 10, document 13).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 20 pulled away from the pit exit light to start the reconnaissance laps after the pit exit light went green. Whilst the driver did rev the engine for a fraction of a second before pulling away, the Stewards do not consider this to be a practice start.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 20 Alleged Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions Practice Start
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
